method_description: Fixed HH, 30 m native linear-power multilooking, exact unbuffered OSM mask, per-date threshold 0.6 times exterior reference median power. No official-data threshold/polarization/buffer fitting.

analysis_policy.land_reference: Complete coarse cells in actual cached AOI outside projected geographic reservoir bbox; cache extends approximately 600 m around bbox. Not a ground-truth land mask or the review screenshot's 5.1 km reference.
analysis_policy.scale_selection: Exploratory five-scale comparison, not independent held-out validation. 30 m is the finest listed scale meeting grade A for both core reservoirs. 10 m also has r > 0.85 for both but Baoshan II interval lower bound is < 0.6.

evaluation: Descriptive associations, not independent predictive validation. Paired bootstrap assumes exchangeable dates; temporal dependence may narrow intervals optimistically.
